what.title: What is Tallaby?
what.lead: Tallaby is an Egyptian platform where you build your own online store in minutes, on your own link or domain, and run it from one dashboard: products, orders, payments, shipping companies, marketing and AI tools.
what.who: Made for sellers who already sell on Facebook, Instagram or WhatsApp and want a real store without writing code.

store.title: A store with your name on it
store.body: Your own store with your logo and colours, at <domain>yourbrand.tallaby.com</domain> or on a domain you own.

money.title: Your sales come to you
money.body: Cash on delivery, InstaPay and mobile wallets, or cards through your own Paymob or Kashier account. Payments go to your accounts, and Tallaby takes no cut of your sales.

shipping.title: You choose how to ship
shipping.body: Tallaby doesn't deliver orders itself. Ship through your Bosta account or your own riders, and follow every order from the dashboard.

free.title: Start free
free.body: Open your store with no subscription and no card, and take orders from day one. Then make a first top-up within {days} days or when your first order arrives, whichever comes first, to keep seeing new orders. Move to Pro's fixed monthly price whenever you like.

features.title: Built for how Egypt sells today
features.mcpTitle: Manage your products by chatting with <claude>Claude</claude> or <chatgpt>ChatGPT</chatgpt>

how.title: Three steps from idea to first order
how.s1Body: Pick your store link, add your email, phone number and a password, or continue with Google.
how.s2Body: Choose a template, add your logo, colors and products, and arrange sections with the visual editor.
how.s3Body: Publish with one click, share your link, and take orders from day one. Then make a first top-up from {topUpMin} within {days} days or when your first order arrives, whichever comes first, to keep seeing new orders.

faq.title: Questions before you start
faq.desc: Can't find your answer? <link>Message us on WhatsApp.</link>

items.q: What does an order cost on the free plan?
items.a: {orderFee} per created order, whatever its value. No monthly fee and no percentage. Your store takes orders from day one; make a first top-up from {topUpMin} within {days} days or when your first order arrives, whichever comes first, to keep seeing new orders and send campaigns.
From about 1,000 orders a month, the flat {pro} costs less than per-order fees. Pro also gives you 2,000 AI credits.
Each AI action, like preparing a product from photos or text, uses one credit. Credits are shared across your whole account, not per team member.

items.q: Can I manage my store from ChatGPT or Claude?
items.a: Yes, for products today. Connect your Tallaby account once, then ask the assistant to add, edit, publish or hide products.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Your store starts on yourbrand.tallaby.com. Connect a domain you own from Website › Domain.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. Design, products, payments and shipping are all set up from your dashboard.

final.title: Your store link is waiting
final.body: Claim it now. Design and publish whenever you're ready.
